Player-Resources/Character-Creation.title: Character Creation
Player-Resources/Character-Creation.content:
Character Creation — In the Heart of Texas Winter
DM: Steve (@ziopsiv)
System: D&D 5e / 5.5e (2024)
Start Level: 8

It’s 2021. Texas is buried under a supernatural blizzard after the Lady of Winter was murdered, violating sacred guest-right. The Fae courts’ rage has torn the veil open. Find the killer, uncover why, and deliver justice. Or freeze.
You are an established operative in the hidden supernatural world beneath mortal Texas. You have been doing this work long enough to be good at it. Level 8 reflects that.

Character Creation Rules
Ability Scores
Choose one method:

Point Buy — 27 points, standard PHB rules
Standard Array — 15, 14, 13, 12, 10, 8 assigned as desired

Hit Points

Level 1: Maximum hit die value + CON modifier
Levels 2 through 8: Average hit die value (rounded up) + CON modifier each level

Allowed Content
Official published sourcebooks only. This includes the 2014 PHB, all published 5e sourcebooks (Xanathar’s, Tasha’s, etc.), and the 2024 PHB and its companion books. No Unearthed Arcana or third-party content.

**Banned: Strixhaven, Mark of Races,
Approval Required: Any really ‘out there’ or niche setting specific races.

I would prefer if you do 2014 rules you stay in 2014 and if you do 2024 you stay in 2024 but it’s mostly on mixing weird interactions vs. I want to play a sub class.
I’m happy to look at something outside of those like the Legend of Avantris or Koboll Press stuff but don’t want to grant carte blanche.
Multiclassing and Feats
Both are permitted as written. No DM approval required.
Starting Equipment

Standard starting equipment for your class and background, plus:
5,000 gp to spend at the [Dungeons of Drunks Magic Item Shop](www.dungeonsof drunks.com) before session 1

Modern Weapons (2014 Rules)
The 2014 modern weapons rules are available. Your character may carry contemporary firearms and modern equipment alongside or instead of traditional fantasy gear. This is 2021 Texas. People own guns.
Modern weapon availability:

Handguns, rifles, and shotguns are accessible to any character
Military-grade weapons require faction justification or background explanation
You should track ammunition within reason. I don’t plan to focus on it but you also don’t have infinite.


Setting Expectations
You are not new to this. Your character has been operating in the hidden world long enough to have a faction, contacts, and a working knowledge of the supernatural.
The Masquerade is real. The supernatural world is hidden from ordinary mortals. Your character knows this and operates accordingly. Powers and abilities that would be visible to civilians are used carefully when they could notice.
Texas in 2021. The setting is contemporary. Your character has a phone, drives a car, etc.
The winter is wrong. Snow is on the ground in San Antonio in June. Civilians are noticing. The situation is escalating. Your character has probably already felt the edges of whatever is causing it.

Choosing Your Faction
Your faction is where your character comes from, who they answer to, and what obligations they carry. It shapes your starting allies, your enemies, and the lens through which you see the crisis.
See the full breakdown: Player Factions
Quick reference:

Things to Bring to Session 1

A completed character sheet at level 8
A faction chosen and a rough sense of why your character is in this work
A reason to be in San Antonio specifically

Player-Resources/Player-Factions.title: Player Factions
Player-Resources/Player-Factions.content:
Player Factions – In the Heart of Texas Winter
Campaign Start: Level 8
You are established operatives within the hidden world of 2021 Texas. Choose one faction below. Your faction gives you allies, obligations, and class and race suggestions.


                  
                  Before You Choose 
                  
                


The race and class suggestions are suggestions.
Any race or class works in most factions — but if you’re a walking Turtle, you need to look human 95% of the time.
Exception — Wizard and Sorcerer Factions:

You can play Wizard/Sorcerer in any other faction without issue.
To play a different class in the Wizard or Sorcerer factions, convince the DM. Multiclassed, Eldritch Knight, or something creative works.






Faction Overview
































































































#FactionTypeStarting AlliesRestricted Classes1The Shattered OathUnseelie / Winter CourtCrimson Cabal—2The Summer CourtSeelie / Summer CourtTexas Rangers—3The Texas RangersMortal Law EnforcementWildblood—4The WildbloodWere-creature AllianceTexas Rangers—5The Crimson CabalVampire FamiliesBoth Courts (neutral)—6The Magisterium DirectorateWizard OrderMortal AuthoritiesWizard / Artificer only7The Order of Saint MichaelMilitant Catholic OrderTexas Rangers—8The Blood SenateAncient Sorcerer BloodlinesAncestral familiesSorcerer only9The IronboundAncient Dwarf ClanTexas Rangers, Magisterium—10The Gideon CompactSouthern Baptist Defense NetworkTexas Rangers, Brotherhood—11The Brotherhood of the Eternal LampRussian Orthodox Christian OrderOrder of Saint Michael, Lamed Vav—12The Lamed VavKabbalistic Jewish Defense CovenantMagisterium Directorate, Gideon Compact—

1. The Shattered Oath (Winter Court)
Description
Sworn agents and loyalists of Cailleach Bheur (KYE-lukh VYUR). Your oath and bond demands you deliver vengeance for her murder and the breaking of guest-right.
Key Associations
Unseelie nobility, winter spirits, and tense cooperation with the Crimson Cabal.
Recommended Races
Drow, Goblin, Bugbear, Hobgoblin, Hexblood, Eladrin, Fairy. Human — but what oaths or deals have you given?
Recommended Classes
Warlock (Fey patron), Rogue, Fighter, Barbarian, Ranger.
Obligations


                  
                  Sworn Duties 
                  
                


Pursue vengeance for the Lady’s murder above all else
Never break guest-right
Report all findings to surviving Winter nobility
Oaths sworn are binding




2. The Summer Court
Description
The official Summer Seelie presence in Texas. You work to contain the crisis, prevent open war between the Courts and mortals, and protect Summer interests.
Key Associations
Summer nobility, mortal elites, and careful diplomatic relations with the Texas Rangers.
Recommended Races
High Elf, Wood Elf, Satyr, Fairy, Harengon, Eladrin. Human — but what oaths or deals have you given?
Recommended Classes
Bard, Paladin, Wizard, Sorcerer, Druid.
Obligations


                  
                  Sworn Duties 
                  
                


Prevent escalation into full war
Never break guest-right
Accurately report to the Summer Court
Oaths sworn are binding




3. The Texas Rangers
Description
Mortal supernatural law enforcement. You protect ordinary Texans and police threats that endanger the Masquerade or mortal lives.
Key Associations
Local law enforcement, old Texas families, and pragmatic ties to the Wildblood.
Recommended Races
Human, Half-Elf, Halfling, Variant Human. At least 50% human.
Recommended Classes
Ranger, Fighter, Rogue, Paladin, Gunslinger.
Obligations


                  
                  Sworn Duties 
                  
                


Protect mortal civilians first
Enforce the Masquerade (keep mortals unaware)
Investigate supernatural crimes




4. The Wildblood
Description
A powerful were-creature alliance fighting for survival as the unnatural winter destroys their territories and endangers their people.
Key Associations
Strong internal bonds and working relations with the Texas Rangers.
Recommended Races
Shifter (any subtype), Human, Genasi, Firbolg, Half-Elf, Half-Orc.
Recommended Classes
Barbarian, Cleric (Nature), Druid, Ranger, Fighter, Rogue.
Obligations


                  
                  Sworn Duties 
                  
                


Protect the pack and its territory above all
Answer the call of the leadership when summoned
Never betray your own




5. The Crimson Cabal
Description
Vampire families who control parts of San Antonio’s nightlife and historic districts. They see both opportunity and danger in the current crisis.
Key Associations
Mortal elites, criminal networks, and careful neutrality with both Courts.
Recommended Races
Dhampir, Reborn, Cleric (Death, Trickery, Arcana).
Recommended Classes
Warlock, Rogue, Bard, Fighter, Wizard.
Obligations


                  
                  Sworn Duties 
                  
                


Protect feeding territories and the Masquerade
Limit new embraces during the crisis
Report useful intelligence to the Cabal elders




6. The Magisterium Directorate


                  
                  Restricted Entry 
                  
                

Only Wizard (any school) or Artificer. Other classes require DM approval.


Description
A powerful order of wizards who believe magic in the mortal world must be regulated, catalogued, and controlled by trained professionals.
Key Associations
Academic institutions, some mortal authorities, and rivalrous relations with the Blood Senate.
Recommended Races
Human, Half-Elf, Half-Orc. Must be at least half human.
Recommended Classes
Wizard (any school), Artificer only.
Obligations


                  
                  Sworn Duties 
                  
                


Contain rogue magic users
Prevent outside forces from corrupting mortal magic
Share critical findings with the Directorate
The Oath of Three

Humanity First
Knowledge Second
The Directorate Third






7. The Order of Saint Michael
Description
A militant Catholic order dedicated to protecting the mortal world from supernatural threats, including unchecked Fae influence.
Key Associations
Hidden elements of the Catholic Church and cooperative ties with the Texas Rangers. Cordial relations with the Blood Senate and Magisterium Directorate — many members are Catholic. They despise the Crimson Cabal.
Recommended Races
Human, Half-Elf, Aasimar, custom holy lineage.
Recommended Classes
Cleric (Life, Light, War, Grave, etc.), Paladin, Fighter, Ranger, Celestial Sorcerer.
Obligations


                  
                  Sworn Duties 
                  
                


Defend mortals from supernatural harm
Uphold Catholic doctrine in dealings with the hidden world
Never make pacts with Fae or demons
Answer calls from Church hierarchy




8. The Blood Senate


                  
                  Restricted Entry 
                  
                

Only Sorcerer (any origin). Other classes require DM approval.


Description
An ancient order tracing its roots to Rome. They seek to guide humanity’s advancement through powerful bloodlines and directed sorcery.
Key Associations
Ancestral families and bloodlines. Your origin determines your specific ties — think 1,000-year-old oaths and obligations. Rivalrous relations with the Magisterium Directorate. Careful neutrality with both Courts.
Recommended Races
Human, Tiefling, Half-Elf, Hexblood, Aasimar, Genasi (any). Must be at least half human.
Recommended Classes
Sorcerer (any origin) only.
Obligations


                  
                  Sworn Duties 
                  
                


Advance bloodline strength and sorcerous power
Contain rogue magic users (unless useful or would improve the bloodline)
Protect and expand Senate influence
Prevent outside forces from corrupting mortal magic
The Oath of Three

Bloodline First
Humanity Second
Power and Knowledge Third






9. The Ironbound (Dwarf Faction)


                  
                  Unique Ability 
                  
                

The Ironbound can craft Cold Iron — one of the few groups in Texas capable of producing weapons effective against Fae.


Description
An ancient dwarven clan that has lived beneath Texas for generations. The unnatural winter is freezing their deep forges and tunnels, threatening their ancient holds. They hold long grudges against the Fae and excel at crafting weapons and tools to fight them.
Key Associations
Other dwarf clans, mortal engineers and miners, and tense but professional relations with the Texas Rangers and the Magisterium Directorate.


                  
                  Ancient Grudge 
                  
                

Grudge against the Blood Senate — They stole/seduced/tricked a dwarf princess 721 years ago. Never forgotten. Never forgiven.


Recommended Races
Dwarf (Mountain or Hill), Duergar, custom dwarf lineage.
Recommended Classes
Fighter, Barbarian, Artificer, Cleric (Forge domain), Paladin, Wizard.
Obligations


                  
                  Sworn Duties 
                  
                


Protect the clan’s underground holds at all costs
Never forgive a slight or broken oath
Obey the clan elders when the holds are threatened




10. The Gideon Compact
Description
A network of Southern Baptist churches across San Antonio that has been quietly fighting supernatural threats for decades. Community is both the weapon and the goal. You protect people by making them stronger, not by standing between them and everything.
Key Associations
Deep community ties with the Texas Rangers. Respectful working relationship with the Brotherhood of the Eternal Lamp. Theologically tense but functionally cooperative with the Order of Saint Michael.
Recommended Races
Human, Aasimar, Half-Elf.
Recommended Classes
Cleric (Light, Life, War, Grave), Paladin, Ranger, Fighter.
Obligations


                  
                  Sworn Duties 
                  
                


Protect your congregation and community first
Never pursue a supernatural threat at the cost of civilian safety
Report findings to the Compact coordinator
Scripture and prayer are your weapons; do not abandon them




11. The Brotherhood of the Eternal Lamp
Description
A small but ancient Russian Orthodox monastic order embedded in San Antonio’s Orthodox community. Their hesychast contemplative practice makes them nearly immune to supernatural corruption. Their formal exorcism rite, conducted in Old Church Slavonic, is one of the most powerful tools available against demonic incursion.
Key Associations
Professional cooperation with the Order of Saint Michael (historical Great Schism acknowledged but bracketed in the field). Genuine respect for the Lamed Vav. Warmer relations with the Gideon Compact than with Catholic factions.
Recommended Races
Human, Aasimar, Half-Elf, Dhampir (seeking redemption).
Recommended Classes
Cleric (Twilight, Life, Grave, Peace), Paladin, Monk.
Obligations


                  
                  Sworn Duties 
                  
                


Maintain the daily prayer rule; the Jesus Prayer does not stop
Perform the rite of exorcism when called upon, regardless of personal cost
Protect the Orthodox faithful as a first priority
Never use demonic means against demonic threats




12. The Lamed Vav
Description
Named for the tradition of the thirty-six hidden righteous people who sustain the world in every generation. The Lamed Vav does not claim to be the thirty-six. They claim to be in the tradition: people who hold, quietly, without recognition, as a sacred obligation rather than a calling to glory. Their tools are among the oldest in the hidden world: Kabbalistic wards, golem-working, the geometry of the divine names, and eleven centuries of documented supernatural threat records.
Key Associations
Productive research overlap with the Magisterium Directorate. Respectful cooperation with the Gideon Compact. Complex but genuine relationship with the Brotherhood of the Eternal Lamp. The most historically complicated relationship in the Accord is with the Order of Saint Michael.
Recommended Races
Human, Aasimar, Goliath (as Nephilim-descended), Genasi.
Recommended Classes
Wizard (Abjuration, Divination, Scribes), Cleric (Knowledge, Grave, Twilight), Artificer (Alchemist).
Obligations


                  
                  Sworn Duties 
                  
                


Protect the Jewish community as a first obligation; the Lamed Vav exists because no one else will
Never weaponize the divine names against the innocent
Maintain the secrecy of Kabbalistic knowledge; it is shared under specific protocols, not freely
Remember: tikkun olam (repair of the world), not its conquest

world/factions/The-Brotherhood-of-the-Et.filePath: world/factions/The Brotherhood of the Eternal Lamp.md
world/factions/The-Brotherhood-of-the-Et.title: The Brotherhood of the Eternal Lamp
world/factions/The-Brotherhood-of-the-Et.content:
The Brotherhood of the Eternal Lamp

“The light shines in the darkness, and the darkness has not overcome it.”

At a Glance





































FieldDetailTypeRussian Orthodox Christian OrderAlignmentLawful GoodStatusActiveHeadquartersSan Antonio — Saint Seraphim of Sarov Orthodox ChurchLeaderFather Arkady VolkovPublic GoalMinistry to the Orthodox community — preservation of the faithfulHidden Goal

Description
The Brotherhood of the Eternal Lamp takes its name from the lampada, the oil lamp that burns perpetually before the icon screen in every Orthodox church, never extinguished, a constant witness in the darkness. The Brotherhood understands itself as that lamp: present when others are not, burning through what would extinguish lesser lights.
They are a monastic order embedded within the Russian Orthodox tradition, operating at the intersection of hesychast contemplative practice and direct supernatural engagement. Their weapons are ancient: the Jesus Prayer repeated without ceasing, blessed icons, holy oil, incense, consecrated relics, and the full liturgical authority of apostolic succession. The Orthodox exorcism rite, formal and demanding and performed only by ordained priests, is their primary tool against demonic incursion.
The Brotherhood came to Texas through the Russian émigré community. Their San Antonio chapter is small by design: seven active brothers, a network of parish contacts, and deep roots in the Orthodox communities of the Southwest. They have held an Accord seat for nineteen years, joining on the strength of Father Volkov’s negotiations.
Their relationship with the Order of Saint Michael is shaped by a thousand years of schism. They share the faith. They dispute the authority of Rome. In the field, this is set aside. In the Dice Drop, it is not always.

Leader
Father Arkady Volkov — Igumen / Chapter Superior
Holds full spiritual and operational authority over the Brotherhood’s Texas chapter. Answers to the diocesan bishop for spiritual matters; for operational decisions within the hidden world, he acts with near-complete autonomy. He has held the chapter superior role for twenty-two years.

Key Associations





























FactionRelationshipThe Order of Saint MichaelProfessional cooperation, historical tension — the Great Schism is never entirely off the tableThe Gideon CompactWarmer than with Catholics — mutual respect without shared sacramental theologyThe Lamed VavDeep respect — the Brotherhood understands ancient traditionThe Shattered OathCautious — Fae are not demonic but are not trustedThe Crimson CabalHostile — the undead are an abomination under Orthodox theology

Recommended Races
Human, Aasimar, Half-Elf, Dhampir (seeking redemption).
Recommended Classes
Cleric (Twilight, Life, Grave, Peace), Paladin (Oath of Devotion), Monk (Way of the Open Hand or Long Death).

Obligations


                  
                  Sworn Duties 
                  
                


Maintain the daily prayer rule — no brother ceases the Jesus Prayer
Perform the rite of exorcism when called upon, without regard for personal cost
Protect the Orthodox faithful as a first priority
Never use demonic means against demonic threats — the weapons must be pure




Resources & Assets

Liturgical Authority: Apostolic succession — their rites carry the weight of unbroken tradition back to the Apostles
Relics: A small but significant collection of authenticated relics with verified supernatural efficacy
Icons: Several miracle-working icons, including one that has been in continuous use since the 17th century
Community: The San Antonio Orthodox community as an intelligence and support network
Contemplative Depth: Hesychast training produces practitioners of unusual spiritual resilience


Theological Distinctives
How they differ from the Order of Saint Michael and the Gideon Compact:

Authority flows through apostolic succession — a priest’s power is real because the chain is unbroken to the Apostles
The Jesus Prayer (“Lord Jesus Christ, Son of God, have mercy on me, a sinner”) is not merely devotional — sustained hesychast practice makes it a continuous supernatural ward
Icons are windows into the divine presence, not representations — a blessed icon carries real protective power
The exorcism rite is lengthy, demanding, and requires the full liturgical apparatus — holy water, oil, incense, specific prayers in Old Church Slavonic — but is correspondingly more powerful than informal methods
Theosis (union with God through sanctification) is the goal; their most advanced brothers are genuinely less vulnerable to supernatural corruption as a result

world/factions/The-Gideon-Compact.title: The Gideon Compact
world/factions/The-Gideon-Compact.content:
The Gideon Compact

“The battle isn’t against flesh and blood. But it’s still a battle.”

At a Glance





































FieldDetailTypeSouthern Baptist Supernatural Defense NetworkAlignmentLawful GoodStatusActiveHeadquartersSan Antonio — Calvary Heights Baptist ChurchLeaderReverend Darnell HollowayPublic GoalSpiritual warfare ministry — protecting communities from supernatural harmHidden Goal

Description
The Gideon Compact is not a single organization with a chain of command. It is a network: a covenant between autonomous Baptist congregations across Texas who have chosen to cooperate against supernatural threats. Each church is sovereign. The Compact is the agreement between them: share intelligence, pool resources, respond together when the need is real.
Named for Gideon of Judges (the reluctant warrior called by God despite his inadequacy, who fought with three hundred men and torches and won), the Compact holds that spiritual authority does not require institutional power. The weapons are scripture, prayer, community, and the faith of ordinary believers. They have found these sufficient.
Their version of exorcism is called deliverance ministry: no formal rite, no holy water or incense, no priestly caste required. A community of believers praying in the name of Christ, with scriptural authority claimed and exercised, addressing the demonic directly. It is messier than the Catholic rite. It works.
The Compact has had a seat at the Accord table for twelve years, joining later than the Order of Saint Michael. Relations between the two are professional and theologically pointed.

Leader
Reverend Darnell Holloway — Coordinator / Senior Pastor
Holds convening authority over the Compact’s Texas network. Each congregation retains its own autonomy; Holloway’s authority is persuasive rather than structural. He is the Compact’s voice at the Accord table and its most experienced field operative.

world/factions/The-Lamed-Vav.title: The Lamed Vav
world/factions/The-Lamed-Vav.content:
The Lamed Vav

“In every generation, they stand between the world and its end. They do not announce themselves. They simply hold.”

At a Glance





































FieldDetailTypeKabbalistic Jewish Defense CovenantAlignmentNeutral GoodStatusActiveHeadquartersSan Antonio — Beit HaMidrash Ohr ChaimLeaderRebbe Yitzchak LoebPublic GoalTorah study and community — the Beit HaMidrash is publicly a house of studyHidden Goal

Description
In Jewish tradition, the Lamed-Vav Tzaddikim are the thirty-six hidden righteous people for whom God preserves the world in every generation. They do not know each other. They do not announce themselves. They simply live righteously and, by their existence, hold the world together. When one dies, another rises to take their place. The world, in this tradition, is always exactly one generation from dissolution — and always exactly sustained.
The faction that calls itself the Lamed Vav does not claim to be the thirty-six. They claim to be in the tradition: people who hold, quietly, without recognition, as a sacred obligation rather than a calling to glory.
Their tools are the oldest in the hidden world. Kabbalistic practice — the mathematics of the divine names, the protective geometry of the Sefirot, golem-working, the wards encoded in mezuzot — predates Christian Europe’s engagement with the supernatural by centuries. The Jewish community has been defending itself against hostile supernatural forces since before most current factions had names, and they have not forgotten what they learned.
The Lamed Vav’s relationship with the other Accord factions is correct and cautious. They remember what Christian Europe did to Jewish communities across a thousand years. They cooperate because the threats are real. They do not forget the history.

Leader
Rebbe Yitzchak Loeb — Rebbe / Chief Kabbalist
Holds the Lamed Vav’s operational and spiritual authority for Texas. The Rebbe is first among equals in a tradition that resists hierarchy; his authority rests on demonstrated scholarship, deep Kabbalistic knowledge, and sixty years of community service. He has held the Accord seat since the faction joined fourteen years ago.

Kabbalistic Wards: Mezuzot, protective circles, the geometry of the divine names — the most comprehensive protective warding system available to any faction
Golem Tradition: Active knowledge of golem-working; the Rebbe has constructed two in his lifetime
The 72 Names: Direct invocational authority over specific divine names — a final-resort weapon rarely used
Community: San Antonio’s Jewish community as an intelligence network; nothing moves in this city without someone in the community knowing


Theological Distinctives
How they differ from the three Christian factions:

The supernatural is addressed through halacha (Jewish law) and kabbalah (mystical tradition) — it is a legal and spiritual matter simultaneously
The divine names (Tetragrammaton and derivatives) are operational tools, not objects of devotion — they are handled with extreme care and invoked rarely
Golem-working is a legitimate and active practice — the creation of a protector from clay, animated by the name of God, is within their tradition and capability
Mezuzot are not merely symbolic — correctly prepared and placed, they create genuine supernatural barriers
The concept of tikkun olam (repair of the world) governs their engagement: they act to restore balance, not to triumph
